name: Murdoc Davis
source: Coach Murdoc Davis is the physical education and head of the Athletics Department. He is merciless when it comes to physical fitness and pushes his students to their maximum. Some say he's crazy, others claim he has a soft side. Regardless, he is known as one of the best athletic coaches in the country.
